senses.zh_definition: Ramlal：见于人名的专名形式；尚未核实小写 ramlal 具有标准马来语普通词义。
senses.en_definition: Ramlal, an attested personal name; no standard Malay common-word sense has been verified.
senses.ms_definition: Ramlal ialah nama khas yang ditemukan dalam nama orang; makna bagi bentuk ramlal sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu belum dapat disahkan. Huraian ini bukan takrif rasmi DBP.
senses.nuances: 人名应写作 Ramlal。学校管理手册载有人名 Ramlal bin Kansa Ramdas，支持其专名用法：[学校管理手册](https://anyflip.com/decaa/gnww/basic)。此证据不能证明它是官方马来语普通词。以下称呼和例句均为教学示例，未核实为高频搭配；输入排名也不能单独证明词条资格。

etymology.historical_story: Ramlal is attested as part of a personal name in a Malaysian school management handbook. This establishes a naming context, but does not establish a Malay dictionary meaning or a particular historical borrowing. The supplied packet contains no etymological evidence. Its linguistic origin, original pronunciation, and historical transmission therefore remain unverified for this entry.
